title: VectorIndexManifest
description: Build manifest for one vector index. The index itself is a disposable derived artifact; this manifest is the durable record that makes it rebuildable and comparable. Exactly one embedding model per index (vector spaces never mix).

x_contract_metadata.authority_note: Planning metadata only; not governance authority and not authorization to run embeddings, build indexes, generate graph edges, import boundary corpora, choose a backend, or promote retrieval profiles.

embedding_model_id.description: Single string by design: one model per index

embedding_model_version.description: Must match the registered embedding model version used for document and query vectors

source_corpus.description: e.g. eng-web_canonical_66; canonical and boundary corpora never share an index

chunk_set_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact chunks.jsonl this index embeds

backend.description: e.g. pinecone, pgvector, lightrag, faiss; the backend is an adapter, never the source of truth

backend_specific_features_used.description: Any backend feature behavior depends on must be recorded here
